## [0.11.0](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/compare/v0.10.0...v0.11.0) (2026-11-10)
### Features
* new mail notifications can show a sign-in code: with Show sign-in codes in new mail notifications turned on (Tools > Options, Settings on the Mac, Preferences on Linux), a message that just arrived with a code, from a site your mail provider says sent it, is announced with "482913 is your code for example.com" first. Off unless you turn it on, as a notification can be read on a locked screen ([2a41d28](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/2a41d283438066bd8d6299084aef48e3e68bbe1e))
The Mac app installs this update itself (Inbox Classic > Check for Updates).

## [0.10.0](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/compare/v0.9.0...v0.10.0) (2026-11-10)
### Features
* one-time codes: a message with a sign-in or verification code shows it in a card above the message, in large type with the domain it is for, and Copy puts it on the clipboard. The code comes from the sender's OTP-Token header or is found in the text, and the card appears only when your mail provider says that domain signed the message, so a code in a forged message is not offered ([c71a72c](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/c71a72ce218a414e08c5b607d3cc9724f71d0a17)) * the message list has no Watch or Size column any more, and the subject gets the room. Watch Conversation and Ignore Conversation are in a message's right-click menu, checked while the conversation is watched or ignored; `larger:` in the search still finds big messages ([4082bff](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/4082bff1d062a81e7ce1e0d8e0c21af3419d2b7f)) * a calendar invitation is shown in a card above the message, in the same style as the cards of bounces and one-time codes, with Open in Calendar on it; the dates read as everywhere else in the app ([60820d3](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/60820d31b99d87b70d8503a742ea224b5084e90c)) * **mac, linux:** with several accounts, each account is a heading over its folders, as in Mail: a click opens or closes it, and the folder shown stays shown. All Inboxes stays at the top ([f7105da](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/f7105daa826903d18cec615287bdfe6c070abc5b))
### Bug Fixes
* security: a sender's address with spaces or a comment around a dot of its domain (`ceo@victim.example .evil.example`) is read with its whole domain, so the From line can not name another domain than the one that was checked; an address holding a control character is not shown as an address. Header text that looks like an encoded word is sent encoded ([30dd7db](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/30dd7db8206371c3b27ee5a8bc32fb7892538b0f)) * Tab goes from field to field in every form, and on to the message and its links in the reading pane ([43a63d9](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/43a63d96ba792b1e8e55543a82e215dff2e2718b), [14d9e41](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/14d9e419788b9f046aeeafdd45407846057a429d)) * **windows:** Enter in a dialog presses its default button: in an AI agent's access prompt that is Don't Allow ([43a63d9](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/43a63d96ba792b1e8e55543a82e215dff2e2718b)) * the "..." of a folded quote has its dots in the middle; **mac:** the rows of the Accounts, Sign-in Apps, AI agents and Outbox windows have their text in the middle, and the sidebar's selection no longer runs under its edge ([b3baf4a](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/b3baf4ab00f49d856a786c1521c2c701ce4db8c6))
The Mac app installs this update itself (Inbox Classic > Check for Updates).

## [0.9.0](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/compare/v0.8.0...v0.9.0) (2026-11-10)
### Features
* the message list groups messages by conversation: a conversation is one row with its count, placed and dated by its newest message, and opens with the +/- box (the triangle on the Mac and Linux) or the Right and Left keys. View > Expand All Conversations and Collapse All Conversations do the whole list, and an action on a closed conversation acts on all of its messages. Tools > Options (Settings on the Mac, Preferences on Linux) turns it off ([fc9469e](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/fc9469e36ed39fc093bd19ed4cd43d2fe4e0cde2)) * Message > Watch Conversation (W) and Ignore Conversation (K): new mail in a watched conversation is always announced, new mail in an ignored one is marked read without a notification, and View > Hide Ignored Conversations takes them out of the list ([6f10659](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/6f10659dbd21a1b0ba376b2bc7dd9cf7998a57b6)) * bounces explained: a message that came back undelivered or delayed says for each address what went wrong, such as an address that does not exist or a full mailbox, and what you can do, with a link to the message that bounced. Bounces are marked in the list, and the search takes `is:bounce` ([f46d86b](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/f46d86b312d9e34211ebd339f0ec9ea325c1010e)) * the Address Book (Tools > Address Book): contacts and groups, Select Recipients behind the To, Cc and Bcc buttons of a new message, groups completed by name in the address fields, Add Sender to Address Book, and import from vCard and CSV and export to vCard in the File menu ([cf0d79f](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/cf0d79f92be1c2e102d8a19d609c1ece8c18ddf1)) * Archive, on the toolbar, in the Message menu and on the A key, moves messages into the account's Archive folder, made the first time when there is none. On Gmail it takes the labels off, leaving the message in All Mail. Undo puts them back ([95e8441](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/95e8441d9f9805378248570c75ada5fea735a99d)) * double-click a message, or press Enter, to open it in a window of its own, with Reply, Forward, Delete, Archive, Junk and Previous and Next through the list it came from ([5f6dba2](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/5f6dba2168e279a702cdc785dae293749faba94b)) * reading with the keyboard: Next and Previous Message, Next Unread Message (N) that goes on to the next folder with unread mail, Go to Folder, and Edit > Find in This Message ([93bbd11](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/93bbd115b4e97c8e310d73954e7338eb189c1558)) * Empty Folder, in the File menu and on the folder's right-click menu, empties Deleted Items and Junk E-mail for good, after asking ([fc6c39c](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/fc6c39cb32610d5b2aeaa35db0508c5c88f8f5aa)) * Sent Items and Drafts show whom each message went to in a To column, and the date column is titled Sent ([a1a010b](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/a1a010b56a5c6a5bb9ffec39137213277f231852)) * all of it in German, Estonian, French and Spanish too, the translations reviewed by native speakers ([851cef4](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/851cef4718467ea3c1b9cd09296dd04b9b80b8f9))
### Bug Fixes
* **windows:** the toolbar keeps its labels after the window is minimized and restored ([bec19ab](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/bec19abdb99a4b789a158a01c5ffb5fbc29ea26a)) * **mac:** the Folder column of a search no longer cuts off the Size column ([c2d5edc](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/c2d5edca045baeb17ebc3c03147aa660adafd4aa))
The Mac app installs this update itself (Inbox Classic > Check for Updates).
